verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server (docs/model-context-protocol) enabling agents to run trends, funnels, HogQL queries, ship feature flags, and pull stack traces directly from MCP clients like Claude, corroborated by the GitHub README describing steering via MCP and a dedicated probe confirming the docs page exists.
